name: notifyMessageWebhook
shortDescription: Sends real-time webhook notifications to external systems when a new secure message is sent.
description:
Overview

This function sends real-time webhook notifications to external systems whenever a new secure Message is sent between a patient and a doctor within the HMP.

Intended use

Invoked as an event handler, specifically on 'post-save' events for the Message entity when a new message is created. It informs external systems about new communications.

Logic

  1. Receive event data containing the newly created Message record.
  2. Format the Message data into a JSON payload suitable for the webhook.
  3. Send the webhook notification to the configured OutboundWebhook endpoint using ctx.webhook.send.
  4. Log the webhook delivery attempt and its outcome using ctx.audit.log.
  5. Return a success or failure status.

Entities

  • Message
  • AuditLog

External Services

  • OutboundWebhook
